Dogs that nothing depends on now always land in the final stage of `plan`, cyclic graph or not. `cargo check -p shep-core` passes; I didn't run any tests.

In `crates/shep-core/src/config/graph.rs`, I moved the push of that stage to after the cyclic stage and the stages that depend on the cycle. The boot-first, ordinary, cyclic, after-cycle and reported-cycle logic is unchanged.

I also updated the doc paragraph on stage order to match: boot-first dogs, the ordinary sort, the cyclic stage, the nodes that depend on the cycle, then the dogs nothing depends on.

Next: run `cargo test -p shep-core --lib` to see whether any existing test pinned the old stage order.
